svg.title: SemiYield four-route engineering analytics roadmap
svg.desc: Four routes cover SECOM manufacturing yield, packaging throughput proxy failure, MOSFET lifetime, and a synthetic three-stage demonstration. A shared engineering platform supports all routes.

g.text: SemiYield · Four-route semiconductor analytics
Evidence, proxy labels and synthetic validation are reported separately.
01 · REAL PROCESS EVIDENCE
Manufacturing yield
Input: UCI SECOM measurements and failure labels
Method: leakage-safe preprocessing · CV · calibrated classifiers
Output: risk ranking · PR-AUC · inspection capture
Boundary: screening evidence, not causal diagnosis
02 · OPERATIONAL PROXY
Packaging process
Input: local mixed process settings and throughput Y
Label: Y < training-only throughput threshold
Output: proxy-failure probability · PR/ROC · confusion metrics
Boundary: proxy label, not physical device failure
03 · RELIABILITY EVIDENCE
Device lifetime
Input: NASA MOSFET degradation, stress temperature, censoring
Method: Weibull · Arrhenius-Weibull · optional survival forest
Output: B10 · η · survival curve · extrapolation warning
Boundary: mechanism and stress-range assumptions remain explicit
04 · SYNTHETIC INTEGRATION
Three-stage demonstration
Input: seeded batches and linked unit IDs
Flow: manufacturing pass → packaging proxy pass → lifetime cohort
Output: funnel · holdout models · threshold · survival · trace
Boundary: synthetic validation, never a real experimental result
Shared engineering platform
uv.lock · data contracts · training-only isolation · hashes and managed artifacts · resource protection · bilingual Streamlit review
